name: Silver Bolts doubles its bonus against Undead and Demons (#3342)
contract: Silver Bolts 804026 reads 'Damage dealt by Heartseeking Bolt, Shadowblast, and Damnation is increased by $s1%, doubled against Undead or Demons or enemies affected by Shadow Trap' with $s1 = 15 (Spell.dbc 2026-09-17). Effect 2 is a SPELLMOD_DAMAGE +15% on Damnation and Heartseeking Bolt. Effect 0 is a raw aura 112 record with the private selector 20014 and MiscValueB 36 (creature-type mask: Demon 1 << (3 - 1) = 4 plus Undead 1 << (6 - 1) = 32), class mask (0x10000, 0x800, 0x10), which nothing reads; native aura 168 honours the effect's class mask once the selector is in MiscValueB (Unit.cpp:8863, 10808). Both factors multiply in MeleeDamageBonusDone (Heartseeking Bolt 805754 and Damnation 520062 are DmgClass 3), so Undead and Demons read 1.15 x 1.15 = 1.3225, inside 1.29..1.33 which also admits an exact 1.30 'doubled'; a non-Undead target reads 1.15. On main the Undead and Demon ratios equal the control's 1.15. Creature types come from data/sql/base/db_world/creature_template.sql: 201 Brittlebones Skeleton type 6 (Undead), 49 Lesser Succubus type 3 (Demon), 36 Harvest Golem type 9 (Mechanical). Shadowblast is not asserted: its class mask sits only in effect 0, so it gets no base +15%, a separate open question. The Shadow Trap clause is a different effect and is not covered.
